description: Terragrunt inputs, read statically: literal values and simple locals, a local terraform source and an included parent. Nothing is run; what is not evaluated is reviewed by name.

cases.name: a Terragrunt input with a literal value is evaluated with the module it runs: a new name replaces the log group, with no coverage review
an input of the parent found by find_in_parent_folders reaches every configuration that includes it
an input that reads dependency outputs is reviewed, naming the dependency (source case: forms-terraform f42289ea)

reasonsContain: Terragrunt configuration env/cloud/app/terragrunt.hcl (input subnet_ids reads dependency.network outputs)

cases.name: an input built from get_env is not known: its change is reviewed, naming get_env, and nothing is read from the environment
a changed generate block is reviewed by name

reasonsContain: generate "provider" changes, and Diffseal does not evaluate it

cases.name: run_cmd is never run: its input is reviewed by name
a terraform source that is not a local path is reviewed, naming it

reasonsContain: env/cloud/app/terragrunt.hcl (terraform source git::https://example.com/modules.git//app?ref=v2 is not a local path)

cases.name: an input the module does not declare is reviewed, and a generate block is named as where it may be declared

reasonsContain: input owner, which modules/app does not declare (a generate block may declare it)

cases.name: terraform.tfvars in the module directory overrides a Terragrunt input, which Terraform reads as an environment variable
a source moved to another local module compares the module it ran at the base with the one it runs now
a change to the module a Terragrunt configuration runs is evaluated with its inputs too, besides the evaluation without them
